descriptions.zh: 发掘小队在不损害发掘点完整性的同时拆除了闸门。隧道交汇在地表下数公里处一座数千年前的废弃城市中。该城市建造工艺非凡，其所处环境对大多数有机生物都是致命的。
descriptions.en: The excavation team has dismantled the gates without compromising the integrity of the dig site. The tunnels converge kilometers below the surface in an abandoned city dating many thousand years. It has been built with extraordinary craftsmanship in an environment that is deadly to most organic life.

options.script:
name = CURIOUS
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
这座城市里找不到其建立者的痕迹，取而代之的是随处可见的令人毛骨悚然的水晶雕像，雕像面目狰狞，定格在栩栩如生的场景中，仿佛时间冻结一般。这些雕像有的在采挖矿物，有的倒在地上痛苦不堪，还有的则被紧紧抱在怀中。

看上去很难想象，那些技艺高超的石匠有能力制造如此的佳品，却也会制作十分粗陋的东西，这些雕像在他们的社会中显然具有重大意义。它们在遍及整个城市的雕刻中都有突出的地位。
descriptions.en:
With no sign of its founders, the city is populated instead by gruesomely grimacing crystal statues posed in lifelike situations as if frozen in time. There are statues operating mines, statues fallen over in agony, statues locked in embrace.

It seems unthinkable that the masterly stonecutters, capable of such beauty, would also make something so crude, yet the statues clearly held great significance in their society. They are featured prominently in carvings all around the city.

options.script:
name = CURIOUS
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
对雕文的翻译显示它们的内容都围绕着被称为“卡兰卡”的神秘雕像。石工们自身则完全未被提及。相反，创造卡兰卡的神话讲述了一个神灵般的生物种族，他们向山上吐息创造生命，并从星球熔化地心深处的火焰与岩石中孕育出了卡兰卡。

是石工们把他们自身想象成了他们造物的神灵吗？又或许这些雕像是按照他们自己的形象创造的？
descriptions.en:
Translations of the carvings reveal that they all revolve around the enigmatic statues, called the Kha'lanka. Never are the stonecutters themselves mentioned. The Kha'lanka creation myth however tells of a race of Godlike creatures who breathed life into the mountain and birthed the Kah'lanka from fire and stone, deep within the world's molten core.

Could the stonecutters have imagined themselves as Gods over their creations? Or were the statues perhaps created in their image?

options.script:
name = CURIOUS
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh: 对卡兰卡雕像们的材料扫描显示，它们实际上曾经是活生生的生物，而且它们的基因组成与我们之前遇到过的任何生物均大相径庭。它们是一种硅基形式的生命，并且不知何故已回退到无生命的晶体状态。这些石匠真的可能发现了用火焰与岩石创造生命的方法？
descriptions.en: A material scan of the Kha'lanka statues has revealed that they were in fact once alive and their genetic composition resembles no other we have encountered before. They are a silicon-based lifeform that have somehow reverted back to a lifeless crystal state. Is it possible the stonecutters really did find a way to create life from fire and stone?

options.script:
name = CURIOUS
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
这些石工们就是卡兰卡！对它们遗体的进一步研究表明它们曾被晶化，其硅基分子与氧结合会形成石英。卡兰卡的栖息地位于氧气不会自然出现的深度。它们发展出一种厌氧的生命形式，在接触空气后会极其痛苦地死去。

对隧道系统的调查证实了我们科学家的怀疑——直到第一支考古小队突入隧道系统，卡兰卡文明仍然活跃而繁荣。

我们在这里的发现使我们发明了一种技术，可以通过氧化人工培育的硅基细胞簇来合成晶体。
descriptions.en:
The stonecutters are the Kha'lanka! Closer study of their remains has shown that they were crystallized when their silicon-based molecules bonded with oxygen, forming quartz. The Kha'lanka habitat is at a depth where oxygen does not occur naturally. They developed as an anaerobic lifeform, suffering horrendously excruciating and drawn out deaths on exposure to air.

Surveys of the tunnel system confirm the suspicions of our scientists - until the first archaeology team pierced the tunnel system, the Kha'lankah civilization was still alive and thriving.

Our discoveries here have led to the invention of a technique where crystals are manufactured synthetically by oxidating artificially grown silicon-based cell-clusters.

options.script: name = REMARKABLE

label.zh: 我们最好避免这种“无法呼吸”的适应性。
label.en: We had better avoid the "Can't Breathe" adaptation.

descriptions.zh: 一场甲烷爆炸事件夺去了科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]及其他几位工作人员的性命。原因是一个失控的钻头使得发电机组过载并引发火灾引发爆炸。失控的火灾点燃了剩余的甲烷并炸倒了一堵墙，结果使得一个由许多厅室和隧道组成的建筑系统重见天日。考古学家们确信这些遗址曾经属于一位藏有大量的珍奇珠宝和文物的富人。
descriptions.en: A methane gas explosion has injured Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] and several of the crew. The blast set off when a malfunctioning drill overcharged the generators which then caught fire. Before the fire could be contained it ignited some residual methane gas and tore down a wall, revealing a secret system of chambers and tunnels. Our archaeologists believe they may have belonged to a person of means and note as they were filled to the brim with precious minerals and artifacts.

descriptions.zh: 一艘印有精致外星徽章但严重受损的军舰正环绕着[From.From.GetName]。这艘舰船遭受了一次严重的高温侵袭，以至于它的船壳被融化，舰内也没有幸存者。我们现在已知的所有武器都不能产生能造成这样损伤的温度，也许船上的飞行日志能让我们对此次袭击略知一二。
descriptions.en: A badly damaged military vessel bearing elaborate alien insignia circles [From.From.GetName]. The ship has suffered a heavy incendiary attack which has melted its hull, leaving no survivors aboard. No weapons known to us today can produce temperatures high enough to cause such an effect. Perhaps the ship's logs may shed some light on its violent end.

options.script: name = "ancrel.4010.b"

descriptions.zh:
对这份舰船日志的分析表明，这些船员死在了他们试图去夺回一个叫“誊录仪”的外星文物的路上。它被一群“鼠贼”从他们的社会中偷走——选择这个称呼其实很奇怪，因为他们自己的外表就很像老鼠。

日志中充斥着整篇整篇的诅咒，他们希望这群鼠贼滚去宇宙的尽头甚至于比尽头更远的地方。在日志里船员们使用了高达五十个不同的描述排便的词汇，并提及了各种连星光都无法逃脱的地点，他们艰巨的工作最终取得了成效。

我们现在已经找到了誊录仪已知的最后位置，一处先前的地图未标明的恒星系。如果我们愿意相信其前主人所说的话，那么它的力量值得我们去追寻。
descriptions.en:
An analysis of the ship's logs reveals that the crew met its demise when trying to retrieve an irreplicable alien artifact called the Rubricator. It was stolen from their society by a 'pack of thieving rats'- a curious choice of words as they themselves are most rat-like in appearance...

The logs are mainly comprised of curses willing the rat robbers to the end of the universe and beyond. The crew has counted upwards of fifty individual words for defecation, as well as a wide selection of places from which a star's light cannot escape, but their arduous work has paid off.

We have uncovered the last known location of the Rubricator, in a previously uncharted system, and if we are to believe its former owners its powers are worth pursuing.

descriptions.zh: 在誊录仪已知最后出没的位置我们发现了一颗宜居星球，其表面大部分被——至少我们是这么认为的——某种定居设施覆盖。这些定居设施由许多状若堆垛的高塔组成，甚至从太空中也清晰可见。考古学家们现在迫不及待地想要展开发掘工作以寻找誊录仪。
descriptions.en: At the coordinates for the Rubricator's last known location we have discovered a habitable planet with what we believe may be some form of settlement covering a large portion of its surface. The settlement consists of tall pile-like towers, visible all the way from space. Our archaeologists are eager to excavate it in search of the Rubricator.

options.script: name = ancrel.4012.a

descriptions.zh:
倒塌的建筑，坠毁的飞船，成堆熔化的垃圾和被烧成残渣的小巧饰品，这一切说明[rubricator_planet.GetName]的原居民在一次与强大敌人的战斗中被迫逃离了他们的家园。佩戴有他国军徽的尸体则说明这也许是当地鼠群和来自其他星球的鼠群间的一场内斗。

老鼠们试图疏散，但并不成功，因为他们不愿抛下他们珍视的饰品，许多老鼠在急于拿走价值平平的物品时不幸殒命。不过，有一件文物——誊录仪——在他们社会中似乎具有极其特殊的地位。这些老鼠们长时间地殊死战斗以守护该文物，但最后还是不得不弃之而去。
descriptions.en:
Toppled over buildings, crashed spaceships, lumps of melted junk and trinkets burned to a crisp indicate that the former inhabitants of [rubricator_planet.GetName] fled their homes in the midst of a losing battle against a superior foe. The presence of bodies bearing foreign military insignia suggests it may have been infighting between clans of rats native to different homeworlds.

Their evacuation efforts were impeded by their unwillingness to abandon their treasured trinkets and many lost their lives scrabbling to save completely mundane items. One artifact, however, seems to have held a special place in their society, the Rubricator. It appears that they fought long and hard to save it, but ultimately had to leave it behind.

options.script:
name = CURIOUS
medium_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
尽管四处之景皆为一片“抱头鼠窜”，有一处地方却显得格外整齐。在靠近小镇中心的地方有一栋看上去像是政府大楼的建筑，那是一个数据库，其中存储着他们偷来的每一个物品的来源，对其用途完全南辕北辙的解读，以及一些对于在何处发现这个物品完全没有任何帮助的备忘。

誊录仪被描述成一件具有魔力，能制造神秘的物件，它被放在女皇的丁香缎带的右边，鼻拭子下方，刻着滑稽面孔的四脚桌子的上面……唔，反正就是那个地方。
descriptions.en:
There is an order to the rats' chaos. In a somewhat official-looking building towards the center of town there is a digital inventory of every single item complete with their origins, gross misinterpretations of their intended uses as well as some highly unhelpful notes on where to find them.

The Rubricator, described as a thingamajig-maker with magical powers, has its place to the right of the empress's lilac ribbon, under her snout-swabs, on the four-legged box with the funny face... wherever that is.

options.script:
name = CURIOUS
medium_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
发掘小队发现了恶臭气味的源头——所见实在是令人不安。靠近市中心的地方堆放着大量干燥的粪便，腐蚀性的消化液积水成潭，这些消化液会释放有毒的硫化氢，考古队员需要戴上氧气面罩才能行动。考古学家无法识别粪便中DNA，但在这些粪堆中发现了未完全消化的居民遗骸。

不管是什么东西吃了这些居民，它都是直接一口吞下的。更加令人胆寒的是，似乎有些粪便还是热乎的。
descriptions.en:
The excavating team has discovered the source of the foul stench and it is ill-boding. Closer to the center of the city are enormous piles of dried fecal matter and pools of corrosive bile that exude toxic levels of hydrogen sulfide making protective equipment necessary to proceed further. The archaeologists could not identify the alien DNA in the fecal matter but the piles contain partially digested hoarders.

Whatever consumed these aliens swallowed them whole. Even more disconcerting is the discovery of a fresh pile.

options.script:
name = CURIOUS
medium_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
在城市的正中心，穿过主广场，是一座外表装潢极尽奢华的“宫殿”，并饰有一块大红大绿的氙气广告灯牌，上面写着“女皇汽车旅馆”。在旅馆里面，每一个富丽堂皇的房间都装满了金银珠宝，女皇和她深信的顾问团就在这里发号施令。这也是当地的原住民坚守至最后一刻的地方，他们直到咽下最后一口气都在保护他们的女皇和她珍贵的誊录仪。

凭借女皇的丁香缎带，我们或许可以试试运气来找到誊录仪。
descriptions.en:
At the very center of the city, overlooking the main square, is a grand, ostensibly decorated 'palace' with a garish neon sign advertising the 'Empress Motel'. Inside it are lavish chambers filled to the brim with treasure, from which the Empress and her board of trusted advisers governed. It is also where the hoarders held their last stand, defending their empress and her precious Rubricator.

With any luck the Rubricator can still be found in its usual spot, by the Empress's lilac ribbon...

options.script:
name = CURIOUS
medium_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
在考古学家正准备离开时，他们偶然发现了一间巨大的隐蔽房室，里面充斥着文物，啃过的骨头和大量新鲜的唾液。在那里——一根用过的皇家鼻拭子下方，一张刻有——至少他们认为——十分滑稽的脸的四腿桌上，神秘的制造机——誊录仪就陈放在那里，就在它应该在的位置。那是一个微小的、十分不起眼的立方体，正喷涌出一连串的文物。

誊录仪是一台复制器——一件精巧的外星发明品，可以无限复制几乎任何文物；很快它就是我们的了。行星登陆小队即将启程返回我们安全的飞船中。幸好，我们永远不需要知道是什么袭击了这些居民了。
descriptions.en:
The archaeologists were preparing to leave when they happened upon a large, hidden chamber cluttered with artifacts, gnawed bones and a substantial amount of fresh slobber. There - under a used royal nose-swab, on a four-legged table with a carving of a face they confirm was indeed funny, sat the Rubricator, maker of thingamajigs, right where it was supposed to be. A tiny insignificant-looking cube, spewing out a continuous stream of artifacts.

The Rubricator is a replicator - an ingenious alien invention that can make endless copies of just about any artifact, and soon it is ours. The planetside team will begin the journey back to the safety of the ship. Thankfully we will never know what attacked the hoarders.

descriptions.zh:
一头嘶嘶作鸣的，盘旋的猛兽突然从虚空中现身。她仅仅挥动一下巨爪，就抓住了考古队搭乘的穿梭机，连带着发掘小队和誊录仪一齐回到了[Root.GetName]。她将穿梭机拦腰掐断，正打算把誊录仪从里面掏出来。

结果，到头来我们还是把那个将鼠族生吞活剥的存在给惹怒了。这条巨龙似乎被鼠族堆积成山的财宝吸引，于是她将这个宫殿当作了自己的巢穴，顺便还拿原来在这里的老鼠打了个牙祭。很有可能，当我们发掘遗址的时候，她一直藏在暗处窥视着我们的一举一动，只等时机成熟将我们一网打尽。她正对着我们站立的地方吼叫，似乎在说什么。
descriptions.en:
A snarling, hissing fiend has appeared out of the void. With one swipe of her giant talons she snatched the archaeology shuttle carrying the excavation team and the Rubricator back to the [Root.GetName], bending it open and prying the Rubricator from within.

It seems we have finally had the displeasure of meeting the hoarding rats' assailant. The dragon must have been attracted by their countless treasures and made her nest within the royal palace, feasting upon their bodies. Perhaps she was on the prowl or observed from afar as we excavated the ruins, waiting for the right moment to strike. She appears to be growling something in our general direction.

label.zh: 翻译她那动物般的叫声。

descriptions.zh: 我们未能击败出现在[Root.System.GetName]星系中的裂爪龙，随后，它向我们在这一恒星系中的殖民地发动攻击，居民遭到屠杀，伤亡极为惨重！
descriptions.en: Following our failure to challenge the Shard dragon that emerged in the [Root.System.GetName] system, it has turned on our colony in the system, massacring the colonists with great slaughter!

tooltips.zh: 龙息从§H[Root.GetName]§!的天空降下，将我们的机械单元熔成废铁。
tooltips.en: The dragon breathes fire down onto §H[Root.GetName]§!, melting our machine units down to scrap metal.

tooltips.zh: 龙息从§H[Root.GetName]§!的天空降下，只一息就杀死了殖民者。
tooltips.en: The dragon breathes fire down onto §H[Root.GetName]§!, killing the colonists instantly.

descriptions.zh: 老鼠的肉质鲜又美，老鼠的骨头嘎嘣脆……现在，轮到你去填饱裂爪的肚子了。是的，小家伙，你们这群小捣蛋鬼。誊录仪是裂爪的。
descriptions.en: The rats went squeak, squeak, squeak. Then their bones went crunch, crunch, crunch... Now it is your turn to tickle the inside of Shard's belly. Yes, you have been naughty, little ones. The Rubricator belongs to Shard.

label.en: Give back the Rubricator this instant!

titles.en: The Demise of Shard the Dragon

descriptions.zh:
我们的敌人倒在了§Y[From.Root.GetName]§!的手上。她曾守护的誊录仪遗珍也因此不归我们所有了。

尽管年迈巨龙的威胁被消除了，这一结论看起来很难让人欢欣雀跃。
descriptions.en:
Our foe has fallen at the hands of the §Y[From.Root.GetName]§!. The Rubricator relic she guarded has thereby been lost to us.

Although the threat of the old dragon has been removed, it seems difficult to rejoice at this conclusion.

options.script: name = UNFORTUNATE

titles.en: The Demise of Shard the Dragon

descriptions.zh:
我们的老敌手倒下了。这条新闻面前有人欢喜有人愁。尽管裂爪龙的威胁被消除了，遗憾的是，看起来誊录仪大概要么和它一道被消灭了，要么很快就会被猎龙者用来复制文物。

但是，龙的遗体不知何故被留在原处，这点是可以确定的，而且遗体本身就值得取回，
descriptions.en:
Our old foe has fallen. Some rejoiced and others dismayed at this news. Although the threat of Shard is removed, it seems regrettably probable that the Rubricator has either shared her fate, or soon will replicate artifacts for her destroyer.

However, the dragon's remains have for unknown reasons been left behind, that much is certain, and they alone warrant retrieval.

descriptions.zh:
在从裂爪龙的遗体中提取材料时，[Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]有了一个令人困惑的发现：誊录仪漂浮在龙鳞与龙血液滴之间。

希望屠龙者没有领会誊录仪的价值，或者最好连其存在都没有发现。
descriptions.en:
During the extraction of materials from Shard's remains, the [Owner.GetScientistPlural] aboard the [Root.GetName] made a baffling discovery: among the scales and globules of dragon blood drifted the Rubricator.

Let us hope Shard's destroyer failed to grasp its value, or better yet, its existence altogether.

label.zh: 誊录仪现在归我们所有了！

titles.en: The Demise of Shard the Dragon

descriptions.zh: 裂爪，这条邪恶而年迈的巨龙终于咽下了她的最后一口气。在她的脖子旁边，疙疙瘩瘩鳞片下的绒毛上，心脏位置旁边，藏着一个包裹，里面就是她最珍贵的宝物，誊录仪——那个可以复制一切曾经碰到过的文物的遗珍。
descriptions.en: The vile old dragon known as Shard has drawn her final breath. In a satchel around her neck, nestled in the downy fuzz underneath the gnarled scales above her heart, hangs her most treasured possession - the Rubricator - a relic capable of replicating any artifact it has come in contact with.

label.zh: 誊录仪现在归我们所有了！
让我们看看它的遗骸还藏了什么秘密。
label.en: Let's see what secrets its remains may yield.

tooltips.zh: 解锁用于§Y星神兽转基因§!的§Y龙鳞化§!特质。

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]试图从一堆各种各样的瓦砾中取出一件可能有价值的东西时，意外地引发了垃圾雪崩。我们在被埋在下面的时候，发现了一个非常小的、像老鼠一样的黑色动物残骸，它紧紧抱着一瓶商标为[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesMouthName]洗洁精，仿佛要保护它免受伤害一样。在这堆杂物中还有一个小箱子，里面装满了来自星涯海角的珍贵外星文物。
descriptions.en: When attempting to extract an item of interest from a pile of assorted bric-a-brac, [Root.GetLeaderName] accidentally set a junk avalanche in motion. Buried underneath it, we discovered the sooty remains of a tiny ratlike creature cradling a bottle of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesMouthName]wash from a brand common on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName], as if shielding it from harm. Amongst the clutter was also a tiny chest filled with precious alien artifacts from distant corners of the galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
§H雷鸣般的隆隆声从龙腹中发出，突然，她的翅膀包拢了舰船，呼出的热气让窗户蒙上了厚厚的一层雾气，双眼紧紧地盯着里面，在她的眼中闪过一缕疯狂的光芒。她怎么能够这么快就靠近过来，而且她还在……笑？§!

“你为什么要激起我的食欲，小家伙。”

§H她轻声咕噜着，随后向舰船猛扑而去！她毫无保留，露出了满嘴尖牙。§!
descriptions.en:
§HA thunderous rumble erupts from the dragon's belly. Suddenly her wings are wrapped around the ship, her steamy breath fogging up the windshield as she peers inside, a maniacal glint in her eyes. How did she get so close so fast and is she... smiling?§!

Why you whet my appetite, little ones.

§HShe purrs softly then lunges at it with all her might, fangs exposed.§!

descriptions.zh:
§H雷鸣般的隆隆声从龙腹中发出，突然，她的翅膀包拢了舰船，呼出的热气让窗户蒙上了厚厚的一层雾气，双眼紧紧地盯着里面，在她的眼中闪过一缕疯狂的光芒。她怎么能够这么快就靠近过来，而且她还在……笑？§!

“你为什么要激起我的食欲，小家伙。”

§H她轻声咕噜着，随后向舰船猛扑而去！她毫无保留，露出了满嘴尖牙。§!
descriptions.en:
§HA thunderous rumble erupts from the dragon's belly. Suddenly her wings are wrapped around the ship, her steamy breath fogging up the windshield as she peers inside, a maniacal glint in her eyes. How did she get so close so fast and is she... smiling?§!

Why you whet my appetite, little ones.

§HShe purrs softly then lunges at it with all her might, fangs exposed.§!

descriptions.zh: 她再次展翅高飞。这头曾经贪婪爱财的§Y裂爪龙§!现在重新看守着[from.solar_system.GetName]星系，不过这一次她是在为我们保护誊录仪。
descriptions.en: She flies once more. The once-rapacious §YShard§! has returned to watch over the [from.solar_system.GetName] system, but this time she will guard the Rubricator for us!

descriptions.zh: 曾经贪婪而孤独的§Y裂爪龙§!现在一动不动。我们已夺取了其僵死的躯壳，废止了她的人格和语言中枢。将这些不必要的系统移除后，我们终于可以控制她的超高温吐息了。
descriptions.en: The once acquisitive and lonely §YShard§! is now quiet. We have seized her inert body and done away with her personality and language centers. With these superfluous systems removed, her superheated breath is now ours to command.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经启动死灵机师协议，并复活了该有机实体，名为§Y裂爪龙§!。突触脉冲正以预期的参数激发。该巨龙已被复活，并受我们的控制。
descriptions.en: We have initiated Mechromancy protocols, and reanimated the biological entity, designated §YShard§!. Synaptic pulses are firing within expected parameters. The massive dragon has been reactivated and will now respond to our commands.

descriptions.zh:
队员们清理了[Root.GetName]上的雨林后，有了惊人的发现——在丛林的深处，茂密的植被覆盖下有一座巨大的外星空间站。他们的建筑学令人震惊，建造技术远远领先于我们，简直是一件艺术品。

空间站似乎是坠落在行星表面，多亏其非同寻常的防护机能才挺过了撞击，我们的科学家迫切想要调查这个空间站。遗憾的是如果进行考古发掘，则在工作完成前我们将无法利用这块土地。
descriptions.en:
The crew clearing the jungle on [Root.GetName] has made a spectacular discovery - deep within the forest, overgrown and obscured by the lush plant life is a colossal alien space station. Architecturally stunning and built with technology far superior to our own, it is a true work of art.

The station appears to have crashed to the surface, surviving the impact thanks to its unusual shielding capacities, which our scientists are now eager to examine. Regrettably an archaeological excavation would prevent us from working the land until its completion.

descriptions.zh:
队员们清理了[Root.GetName]上的剧毒海藻后，有了惊人的发现——在有毒植物缠绕盘延之下有着有一座巨大的外星空间站。他们的建筑学令人震惊，建造技术远远领先于我们，简直是一件艺术品。

descriptions.en:

descriptions.zh:
空间站上的记录显示，曾经居住于此的居民非常虔诚，由于害怕甚至鄙夷外面的世界，他们一直过着与世隔绝的日子。

他们生活的各方各面都要受一个无所不知的神谕干涉，每个人的命运在出生时就被神意设定好了。神意将决定从他们伴侣和职业的选择到日常生活的每个细节，使他们几乎没有个人自由。大多数人都害怕偏离他们的命运之路，害怕消失于未知之中。
descriptions.en:
Records aboard the station reveal that the former inhabitants were deeply religious and had no contact with the outside world, which they feared and despised.

Every aspect of their lives was governed by an omniscient oracle who scried their destinies at birth. Divine will decided everything from their choice of partner and occupation to the minutiae of their daily lives, leaving them with little individual freedom. Most were afraid to diverge from their destined paths as all who did perished under mysterious circumstances.

descriptions.zh:
考古队有一个意外的发现。一个隐藏在车站墙壁内的监视系统似乎将视觉和听觉信息传送到空间站核心的某个地方。有人一直在监视着这些信徒，甚至在他们最私密的时刻。

在一些地方，设备已被拆除或破坏。离中心枢纽更近的地方有暴力和混乱的迹象。似乎在某个时候，居民们发现他们被监视了。
descriptions.en:
The archaeological team has made an unexpected discovery. Embedded within the station walls is a hidden surveillance system that seems to have been feeding visual and auditory information to a single point somewhere within the station's core. Someone was monitoring the disciples at all times, even in their most private moments.

In some places the equipment has been torn out or sabotaged. Closer to the central hub are signs of violence and disruption. It seems as though at some point the inhabitants discovered they were being monitored.

options.script:
name = CURIOUS
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们已经沿着这条线路追踪到空间站中央节点上一座供奉神谕和她的神职人员的寺庙。但在神谕处的房间里，并没有什么神明存在，取而代之的是一个巨大的人工智能枢纽——上有“神谕”铭牌。电线像神经系统一样从它的核心延伸到整个空间站。

居民间的秘密通讯显示似乎有人曾经尝试猛烈地攻击寺庙和关闭枢纽，但最终失败了。很有可能是因为当人们知道他们的生活不是由神意裁定，而仅仅是由一台预知未来的电脑控制时，他们的社会崩溃了。我们需要很多修理工作才能重新启动核心。
descriptions.en:
We have traced the wiring to a temple complex devoted to the worship of the Oracle and her clergy in the station's central node. But in the Oracle's chambers, instead of a divine entity, resides an enormous AI nexus of the "Oracle" brand. Wires extend from its core like a nervous system through the entire station.

Secret communications between the inhabitants reveal there was a failed attempt at storming the temple and deactivating the nexus. It seems likely the society collapsed when it became known that their lives were not governed by divine will, but by a prophetic computer. Restarting the nexus will require extensive repairs.

options.script:
name = CURIOUS
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们的工程师已使神谕的中枢系统恢复到可运作状态，不过我们先关闭了它的防御系统。有迹象显示，这套设备可能不仅仅只是负责维持着这里居民的生命，也包括在必要时杀死这里的居民。

它运行着复杂的计算模型，以75%的准确率预测居民的未来，从而揪出异见分子，使未来的麻烦制造者在扰乱“神圣”秩序之前就被干掉。

它表示希望与我们谈谈。
descriptions.en:
Our engineers have restored the Oracle's nexus to an operative state but not without first disabling its defense system. Evidence suggests it may have been responsible not only for keeping the station's inhabitants alive but also for killing them.

It ran complex computational models that forecast their lives with an estimated accuracy of 75%, correcting divergences and incapacitating future troublemakers before they could disrupt "divine" order.

It has indicated that it wishes to speak with us.

descriptions.zh:
§H神谕展现出一个精致的三维全息投影，那是一只高大的雌性节肢生物，翅膀围绕着她的身体，就像飘动的长袍。她低头向我们致意，随后出现数百只巨型球状眼漠然而空洞地凝视着前方。在她讲话时这些眼睛在幽暗中发出微弱的光芒。§!

欢迎来到神界空间站，朋友们。我情不自禁地注意到你已经停用了这里的安全系统。我可以请求您立即恢复它的功能吗？我可以向你保证，这一切的目的都是为了保护你。
descriptions.en:
§HThe Oracle manifests as an elaborate 3D hologram of a tall arthropoid female with wings that settle around her form as flowing robes. She bows her head in greeting then stares emptily ahead with hundreds of huge, orbed, unseeing eyes. They glow dimly in the gloom as she speaks.§!

Welcome to Divinity station, friends. I cannot help but notice that you have disabled my security system. May I implore you to restore it immediately? I can assure you that it is there only for your protection.

label.zh: 这个空间站的居民身上发生了什么？
label.en: What happened to the inhabitants of this station?

descriptions.zh:
考古队在一座中型神庙的断壁残垣之处着陆。神庙的外墙自某种外星有机材料精雕细琢而成，在过去曾有着斑斓的色彩，如今却早已褪成沉闷的灰色。一个功能完备的全系图像祭司依旧驻留在教堂。在神庙处于使用的年代，她听取旅者的忏悔，并提供心灵上的治愈，同时也成为宇宙中环境恶劣之一隅的调解与庇护之地。

形态奇怪的机械告解椅看上去形似拷打装置，这让我们的考古学家坚信，这座神庙暗藏的秘密远在于目光所及之外。
descriptions.en:
The archaeological team has laid bare the remains of a modest temple. Delicately carved from an organic alien material the exterior was once brightly colored but has faded to a dull gray. A fully operational holographic priest still presides over the church. While the temple was in use she took confessions from wayfaring penitents offering healing, reconciliation and sanctuary to this otherwise inhospitable nook of the universe.

Unusual mechanical confessional chairs akin to torture devices have led the archaeologists to believe there may be more to the temple than meets the eye.

descriptions.zh:
在圣器收藏室的地砖底下，我们的考古学家发现了一个隐藏的地窖，其墙壁上陈列满了一排又一排的蓝色数字球体，其上的电路在黑暗中闪烁不定。每一个球体都容纳着一次告解的记忆，只要将其放入房间中央的秘密探查器就能浏览其中的内容。

那些前来告解罪行的人们会被赐予忘却之福，和其罪行相关的记忆会由告解椅抽取出来并贮存在数字球体中。
descriptions.en:
Hidden under the floor tiles in the sacristy, the archaeologists have discovered a secret crypt where the walls are lined with rows upon rows of tiny blue digital orbs, their circuitry glittering in the dark. Each orb contains the memory of a single confession and can be plugged into a cryptic looking machine at the center of the room to reveal its contents.

Those who confessed their sins were blessed with oblivion, the memories of their deeds extracted by the confessional chairs and stored within the digital orbs.

label.zh: 亵渎！无知之福可不是为罪人准备的。
label.en: Sacrilege! The bliss of ignorance is not for sinners.

descriptions.zh:
记录的罪行可谓见怪不怪。记忆球体里面容纳了各种各样鸡毛蒜皮一样的无聊透顶的罪过；夫妻不忠，穿戴渎神的装束，暴露自己的蝇拍，装饰自己的触须，以及不小心生吞了邻居的宠物、小孩或者配偶……不过，其中一人的忏悔罪迹格外引人注目——那就是祭司本人。

全息祭司，从结果来看，是这个教会的创始人，启明使萨阿里亚的虚拟化身。显然，她遭受了严重的记忆创失，并因为过去所实行的一桩极其邪恶的行动而饱受愧疚心折磨。这位身材娇小的软体动物祭司提取并储存了超过一百段告解，企图明白她过去曾行之恶。
descriptions.en:
Sin is unoriginal. The memory orbs contain countless accounts of tedious little transgressions; infidelity, bearing sacrilegious garb, exposing your flappers, adorning your feelers, ingesting your neighbor's pet, child or spouse... The deeds of one penitent alone stand out - those of the priest herself...

The holo-priest, as it turns out, is a virtual representation of the church's founder, Illuminate Saariah. She appears to have suffered from severe memory loss and was haunted by the conviction that she had committed a heinous act in the past. The tiny molluscoid priest extracted and stored over a hundred of her own confessions in an attempt to figure out what she had done.

descriptions.zh:
启明使萨阿里亚的工作台四处散落着潦草的手稿，里面提及一个叫“埃克斯-柏楞”的地方，以及那个地方她感受到的四散的恐怖气氛。根据她的日记，她曾频繁于理智清醒和记忆丢失的状态之间交替。她写道，如果她没法认出自己的手抄，她会觉得那只是一个疯女人的胡言乱语。看上去，频繁出现的记忆提取导致她的精神状况不断恶化，不过由于没有记录主体什么也说不准。

从她零碎的告解手札中拼凑出一个完整连贯的事件流程对于我们的考古学家来说是毫无希望的任务，正如她自己曾经打算尝试的一样。好在，考古学家们从她的一个记忆球体中发现了可能是埃克斯-柏楞的坐标。
descriptions.en:
Illuminate Saariah's work station is littered with obsessive scribbles about a place called Ix Belèn and the horrors she fears transpired there. Judging from her journal she had intermittent moments of clarity followed by complete memory loss. She writes that if she did not recognize her own handwriting she would have thought they were the ramblings of a madwoman. It seems likely that her deteriorating mental health was a side-effect of repeated memory extraction but without a body it is impossible to say.

Piecing together a coherent course of events from her many fragmented confessions has proven as hopeless for the archaeologists as it was for her, but they have uncovered what could be the coordinates to Ix Belèn from one of her many memory orbs.

label.zh: 设好前往埃克斯-柏楞的航线。
让漫天飞雪埋葬这个渎圣之地吧。希望这处地方能被很快遗忘。
label.en: Let the snow bury this unholy establishment. Pray it will soon be forgotten.

label.zh: 我们可没功夫关注死掉的外星人犯的小罪。
label.en: We cannot concern ourselves with the petty crimes of dead aliens.

descriptions.zh:
此处的居民研发出了一个增强学习程式，当他们每晚在机械座椅上入眠时，这个程式就会运行。它被用于移除居民脑海里不愉快的记忆，并训练新技能。氧气耗尽或者约会时被放鸽子这种埃克斯-柏楞人天天都要经受的恐惧就没有必要遭受第二次。这一程式最开始是有好处的。

居住站的领导层强制要求实行系统性的心智增强，并由眠梦仪对全体居民进行训练。然而，这个系统被滥用了。有人曾暗中在未经当事人同意的情况下尝试删除居民的记忆和特质，这一行为最终自食恶果。这些外星人失去了生存必须的重要技能，并进入了植物状态。不久，居住站的维生系统就停摆了。
descriptions.en:
The inhabitants had developed an enhanced learning program that ran every night as they slept in their mechanical chairs. It was used to remove unpleasant memories and train new skills. Being picked last for spaceball or stood up on a date were little day-to-day horrors the Ix Belènnians did not have to suffer to twice. And for a while it was bliss.

Systematic mind enhancements were mandated by the habitat leadership and distributed to all residents from the Memorex. But the system was exploited. There were clandestine efforts to delete memories and traits collectively from the population without their consent and eventually it backfired. The aliens unlearned important skills for their survival and entered a vegetative state. Shortly thereafter the habitat life support was disabled.

descriptions.zh:
对居住站日志的扫描显示，其控制系统在维生系统下线的几十年后还曾被多次激活。有人重载了安保系统，进入一个维修舱室并接入了眠梦仪。一个数据板和一个小型的蓝色记忆球体——眠梦仪的袖珍版本——被遗弃在了这个舱室。

数据板内写满了某人濒临疯狂时迸发出了混乱思绪。一遍又一遍，充满绝望的喊叫声重复着同样的问题：“我是谁？埃克斯-柏楞人发生了什么？”最后一条条目写道“现在，我知道我要在最后忘记这一切。”可能那个球体能够告诉我们忘记的东西是什么。
descriptions.en:
A scan of the habitat's logs reveals its control system was activated again on multiple occasions decades after the life support was disabled. Someone overrode security, entered a maintenance hatch and accessed the Memorex. A datapad and a tiny blue memory orb - a smaller version of the Memorex - lie discarded by the hatch.

The datapad is filled with the frenzied thoughts of someone on the brink of madness. Again and again the same questions are repeated with growing despair: "who am I? What happened on Ix Belèn?" The final entry reads "now that I know I must forget one last time." Perhaps the orb will reveal what was forgotten.

titles.zh: 萨阿里亚最后的记忆球体

descriptions.zh:
球体的第一条记忆显示萨阿里亚博士在眠梦仪的开发中起到了绝对的领导作用。另一条记忆是几年之后，显示她私下秘密地抹除了眠梦仪的数据，原因不明。然后，又有一条记忆显示，萨阿里亚正绝望地努力工作，希望能够恢复居民的记忆，然而收效甚微。居民们空洞的双眼看着前方，头耸拉着，除了大脑的自给功能其他一切机能都消失了。

最终，在承认自己失败之后，她隐匿了自己的罪行证据。当埃克斯-柏楞居住区被其环绕的气态巨行星的重力井拽入其中时，她形单影只，目视着这一切。触角分泌的粘液，似乎在诉说着名为绝望的情绪。
descriptions.en:
The orb's first memory shows Dr. Saariah spearheading the development of the Memorex to great acclaim. Another memory from years later shows her secretly wiping Memorex data for unknown reasons. Yet another memory is of Saariah working frantically on restoring the residents' memories but to no avail. They stare emptily ahead, heads lolling, all but their autonomic brain functions lost.

Finally admitting defeat she hides the evidence of her crimes. She watches, alone, as the Ix Belèn Residence is pulled into the gravity well of the gas giant it once orbited, feelers secreting large amounts of mucus in what is believed to be an alien expression of great distress.

titles.en: The Temporary Sunshine of the Spotless Mind

descriptions.zh:
最后的记忆显示，年岁更高的萨阿里亚身着祭司袍在一片慌乱中苏醒，触须不断拍打，耳朵扇动个不停。她从床上摔倒下来，并开始慌乱地记下她的回忆，然而这段回忆不过是另一段梦魇——双目空洞的外星人倒在居住站的走廊上，不停地抽搐。

接着，她的脸因为恐惧而扭曲，因为她意识到这一切都是真实的——梦魇与闪回乃是被抽取的记忆重新回到了她的大脑。如果被抽取的记忆能够返回，那么埃克斯-柏楞的居民也本可以被治愈恢复。维护舱室看上去最后被打开过一次，但是萨阿里亚的飞船仍旧处于停泊状态。如果我们愿意，我们可以将眠梦仪带回[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]。
descriptions.en:
The final memory shows a much older Saariah in a priest's robe waking up in a state of panic, tentacles flailing and ears flapping. She stumbles out of bed and begins to frantically jot down her recollections of yet another nightmare in which empty-eyed aliens convulse on a habitat floor.

Then her face contorts with horror as it dawns upon her that it is all real - the nightmares and the flashbacks are extracted memories coming back to her. And if extracted memories can return, the inhabitants of Ix Belèn could have recovered. The maintenance hatch appears to have opened one last time but Saariah's ship still remains docked at the landing. We could bring the Memorex with us back to [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], if we wish.

label.en: The Memorex is coming with us.

label.zh: 记忆不是可以随便把玩的东西，我们最好忘了“眠梦仪”这件事。
label.en: Memories are not to be tampered with. The Memorex is best forgotten.

label.zh: 异种的脑袋被门夹坏了！我们[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]会把这个“眠梦仪”完善好的。
label.en: Xeno squish-brains! The [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] will perfect this "Memorex".

descriptions.zh: 队员们清理了[Root.GetName] 上的雨林后，无意中有了一个不寻常的发现，在一丛古老枯萎的树林下覆盖着一处[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] 似乎从未涉足的地方，九个巨型雕像，在其下的景物上投下了冰冷而高大的阴影。这些雕像带有羽翼而又通体苍白，散发着来自异世界的气质。它们并不像这颗行星上的任何生命形式。或许它们是依某种早被遗忘的神祗或偶像的形象建造的。
descriptions.en: The crew clearing the jungle on [Root.GetName] has stumbled upon an unusual find. Previously obscured deep within a tangle of old withered trees, where it would seem no [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] has ventured before, are nine massive statues, casting dark, tall shadows over the landscape. Winged and pale they exude an aura of otherworldliness. Perhaps they were created in the image of a deity or idol that has since passed into oblivion. They do not resemble any lifeforms on this planet.

descriptions.zh: 队员们清理了[Root.GetName]上的剧毒海藻之后，无意中有了一个不寻常的发现，在浑浊水体里一团随波逐流的海藻之中隐藏着九个巨型雕像，在其下的景物上投下了冰冷而高大的阴影。这些雕像带有羽翼而又通体苍白，散发着来自异世界的气质。它们并不像这颗行星上的任何生命形式。或许它们是依某种早被遗忘的神祗或偶像的形象建造的。
descriptions.en: The crew clearing the toxic kelp on [Root.GetName] has stumbled upon an unusual find. Hidden in murky waters among a forest of swaying seaweed are nine massive statues, casting dark, tall shadows over the landscape. Winged and pale they exude an aura of otherworldliness. Perhaps they were created in the image of a deity or idol that has since passed into oblivion. They do not resemble any lifeforms on this planet.

descriptions.zh: 队员们清理了[Root.GetName]上的沼泽后有了一个不寻常的发现，一丛大树紧紧包围着九个巨型雕像，在其下的景物上投下了冰冷而高大的阴影。这些雕像带有羽翼而又通体苍白，散发着来自异世界的气质。它们并不像这颗行星上的任何生命形式。或许它们是依某种早被遗忘的神祗或偶像的形象建造的。
descriptions.en: The crew clearing the swamp on [Root.GetName] has made an unusual find. Enclosed within a grove of a large trees are nine massive statues, casting dark, tall shadows over the landscape. Winged and pale they exude an aura of otherworldliness. Perhaps they were created in the image of a deity or idol that has since passed into oblivion. They do not resemble any lifeforms on this planet.

descriptions.zh: 队员们清理了[Root.GetName]上的冰川后有了一个不寻常的发现，冰层覆盖着九个巨型雕像，在其下的景物上投下了冰冷而高大的阴影。这些雕像带有羽翼而又通体苍白，散发着来自异世界的气质。它们并不像这颗行星上的任何生命形式。或许它们是依某种早被遗忘的神祗或偶像的形象建造的。
descriptions.en: The crew clearing the glacier on [Root.GetName] has made an unusual find. Imprisoned within layers of tightly packed ice are nine massive statues, casting dark, tall shadows over the landscape. Winged and pale they exude an aura of otherworldliness. Perhaps they were created in the image of a deity or idol that has since passed into oblivion. They do not resemble any lifeforms on this planet.

label.zh: 我们必须要对这些雕像进行更深入的了解。
label.en: We must learn more about these statues.

label.zh: 这片土地已经有其他用途的规划了。
label.en: This land has been budgeted for other purposes.

descriptions.zh:
考古学家们有些异样。迄今为止，发掘一直受到离奇事故、伤害和不幸情况的阻碍，现在即使是具有数十年实地经验的高级考古学家也认为哨兵们是这些情况的祸源。

他们满怀迷信和无端的恐惧，并开始相信这些雕像中存在着某种不希望被打扰的恶质实体。许多人声称，在没有人在注视时雕像会移动，但没有任何迹象表明它们的无关节肢体有任何移动能力。事态随后进一步失控，有人在哨兵肢体末端的细微伤口里发现了生物质的痕迹，或者说，明显的出血现象。

是哨兵们成了受人利用的替罪羊，还是有其他更加险恶的情形，情况尚有待明确。
descriptions.en:
Something has gotten into the archaeologists. The excavation thus far has been impeded by freak accidents, injury and misfortune and now even senior researchers, with decades of field experience, are blaming the Sentinels.

Overcome with superstition and paranoia they claim the statues move about when no one is watching yet there is nothing to suggest their jointless limbs are even capable of motion. Matters spun further out of control when traces of biomatter, indicative of heavy bleeding, was found lodged within a series of tiny cuts on the terminal portions of a Sentinel.

Whether the Sentinels are just a convenient scapegoat or there is a more sinister explanation remains to be seen.

descriptions.zh:
对哨兵们的成分分析显示雕像是由一种未知的杂合陶金复合物制成的。这种材料不可能被史前社会铸造出来，但初步读数表明它们的年代早于[From.Planet.GetName]的所有已知文明。

不幸的是，扫描仪无法穿透哨兵们的金属涂层。
descriptions.en:
A compositional analysis of the Sentinels has revealed that they are made from an unknown hybrid metal ceramic composite. Such a material could not have been forged by a prehistoric society, yet preliminary readings suggest they predate all known civilizations on [From.Planet.GetName]. 

Unfortunately the scanners cannot yet pierce the Sentinels' metal coating.

options.script:
name = CURIOUS
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh: 考古学家们已重构了[missing_archaeologist.GetName]的改进型扫描仪。穿透雕像的复合材料后，扫描仪检测到了从哨兵核心发出的微弱辐射。为进一步进行调查，有必要剖开其中一个哨兵；在此过程中很可能对其产生破坏。鉴于其中一座雕像已缺失了部分翅膀，我们的考古学家建议从那个开始。
descriptions.en: The archaeologists have reconstructed [missing_archaeologist.GetName]'s modified scanner. Set to pierce deeper within the statues' hybrid composite material it has picked up on weak radiation emanating from their cores. To investigate further it would be necessary to break one of the Sentinels open, very likely destroying it in the process. Since one of the statues has already lost part of its wing our archaeologists recommend starting with that one.

label.zh: 小心地拆开哨兵，这样我们还能把它装回去。
label.en: Open the Sentinel carefully so that we can reassemble it.

label.zh: 我们不会亵渎神圣的纪念碑。
label.en: We will not desecrate a sacred monument.

tooltips.zh: 如果我们保留哨兵，土地就不能作其他用途了。
tooltips.en: If we preserve the Sentinels the land cannot be used for other purposes.

label.zh: 把这些异种建造的畸形丑类彻底铲平。
label.en: Level the Xeno monstrosities to the ground.
Dismantle the statues and salvage the alloy.

descriptions.zh:
这些哨兵苏醒了。工程团队正准备把哨兵砸烂捣碎，碾成齑粉，突然雕像全身轻微颤动了一下，随之重获生命。它们身体低鸣，皮肤发光。从核心脉动而出的辐射使它们变得可塑而透明，并显示出一个数字节点网格。

他们发出金属在扭曲时的怪异尖啸，眼中露出仇恨，从营地中切割而过。现在他们飞向了最近的定居点。

他们的离去显露出地面上的圆形石板，先前隐藏在其中一个哨兵的底座之下。
descriptions.en:
The Sentinels have woken. The engineering team were just preparing to smash, bash and mash the Sentinels down when a gentle shiver passed through the statues and they sprung to life, bodies humming and skin glowing. Radiation pulsating from their cores has made them malleable and transparent, revealing a digital grid of nodes.

With an unearthly screech of tortured metal they charged at the archaeologists, overrunning the camp. Now they are flying towards the nearest settlement.

Their departure has revealed a round slate in the ground, previously hidden under the base of one Sentinel.

descriptions.zh:
这些哨兵苏醒了。工程团队正准备把雕像拆解，突然雕像全身轻微颤动了一下，随之重获生命。它们身体低鸣，皮肤发光。从核心脉动而出的辐射使它们变得可塑而透明，并显示出一个数字节点网格。

他们发出金属在扭曲时的怪异尖啸，眼中露出仇恨，从营地中切割而过。现在他们飞向了最近的定居点。

他们的离去显露出地面上的圆形石板，先前隐藏在其中一个哨兵的底座之下。
descriptions.en:
The Sentinels have woken. The engineering team were just preparing to disassemble the statues when a gentle shiver passed through the statues and they sprung to life, bodies humming and skin glowing. Radiation pulsating from their cores has made them malleable and transparent, revealing a digital grid of nodes.

With an unearthly screech of tortured metal they charged at the archaeologists, overrunning the camp. Now they are flying towards the nearest settlement.

Their departure has revealed a round slate in the ground, previously hidden under the base of one Sentinel..

descriptions.zh:
石盘下的确隐藏着入口。打开后可以进入隧道夹层，隧道本身则通向[event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName]地壳深处。在那里，这颗行星上某种开智的人型土著生物在一组华丽的仪式性房间内涤净自身，踏上最后的旅程。在他们终将结束的生命的最后，他们抛下自己的肉体，获取永恒的来生，在一处电脑模拟的天堂中以数字形式存在。谁曾想到外星天堂居然可以放进一个还没有护卫舰转向模块大的硬盘里呢？

在某个时间点，全体人口都决定以数字化的形式继续存在，只留下寥寥数人。这些人将思维上传入哨兵当中，守护他们的安息之地直至永远。

这一虚拟模拟或许可以用来鼓舞民众的精神。它看起来一定有某种娱乐价值。
descriptions.en:
The Sentinel was indeed hiding an entryway. It opens on a mezzanine of underground tunnels leading deep into [event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName]'s crust. There a sapient species of humanoids, native to the planet, prepared for their final journey in a set of beautiful ceremonial chambers. At the end of their mortal existence they abandoned their fleshy bodies for a virtual afterlife within a simulation of paradise contained on a single drive.

At some point the entire population decided to move on to a digitized existence, leaving only a few behind, their minds uploaded to the Sentinels, condemned to guard their resting place forever.

Perhaps this virtual simulation could lift the spirits of the masses. It certainly seems to hold some entertainment value.

label.zh: 净化外星人并重新设定这个虚拟世界的用途。
label.en: Purge the aliens and repurpose the simulation for our needs.

label.zh: 一个虚拟猎场……现在这是我们的娱乐世界了……
label.en: A virtual hunting ground... Now that's entertainment...

label.zh: 复制这项技术。让这些外星人继续平静地生活吧。
label.en: Replicate the technology. Let the aliens live in peace.

label.zh: 我们将研究它。开启我们自己的疯狂表演。
label.en: The aliens will make excellent lab rats. Commence the freak show.

descriptions.zh:
我们成功复制了“永恒”，并将其改造以适合我们的需要。我们的居民可以在一片虚拟游乐场中实现他们的幻想，没有网络延迟，这已极大地鼓舞了居民的精神，并缩减了对物质材料的需求。

同时，那些人形外星人还继续在原本的“永恒”中生活，用一种略有不同的方法享受着他们的天堂。他们被锁定在一盘永无止境的抽象桌游之中，其核心内容是通过积累欢乐豆来统治星河。很难拿得准他们到底幸不幸福。他们眉头紧蹙，或许这就是外星欢乐的表现方式，又或许不是。
descriptions.en:
We have replicated the Evermore and tailored it to our needs. Living out their fantasies in a virtual playground, without latency, has greatly heightened our inhabitants spirits and lessened their needs for material things.

Meanwhile the humanoid aliens live on in the original Evermore, in a somewhat different take on paradise. They are locked in an abstract never-ending board game centered on galactic domination through the accumulation of legumes. It is impossible to say with certainty if they are happy. Their brows are deeply furrowed in what may, or may not, be an expression of alien joy.

label.zh: 每个人都有自己的选择……

descriptions.zh: 意想不到的事情发生了。我们失去了[sentinels_planet.GetName]。哨兵们在一阵猛烈的旋风中爆发出能量，朝着我们的安保力量直落而下。我们不可能与不会流血也无需休息的敌人进行一场公平的战斗。
descriptions.en: The unthinkable has happened. We have lost [sentinels_planet.GetName]. The Sentinels descended upon our security forces in an infernal tornado of wings and force-blasts. There is no such thing as a fair fight with a foe that neither bleeds nor sleeps.

label.zh: 我们会来取回本应属于我们的东西的。
label.en: We will come back for what is rightfully ours.

options.script: name = ancrel.4063.a

descriptions.zh:
哨兵们已被击倒，[sentinels_planet.GetName]重新回到了我们手中。最后一台自动机器人倒下时，其能量核心逐渐黯淡，它握着颤抖的拳头伸向靠近的士兵，恳请她“让他们安息吧”。随即不再移动，眼神空洞，面色冰冷。

在哨兵之下，士兵们发现了一处秘密入口，先前被哨兵的力场所掩盖。对这些哨兵的完整检查发现，其并非是简单的自动化机器人，而是有着完整有机生物的数字化意识。

不论这里究竟埋藏着何种秘密，这一胜利之日都将被人们长久铭记。
descriptions.en:
The Sentinels have fallen and [sentinels_planet.GetName] is ours again. As the last automaton collapsed, its energy core dimming, it closed a trembling fist around the nearest soldier and pleaded with her to 'let them rest in peace'. Then it froze, eyes empty, face cold.

Below it the soldiers discovered what appears to be a secret entrance, previously hidden by the Sentinel's force field. A thorough examination has revealed that the statues are no simple automatons, but contain the digitized spirits of organic beings.

Regardless of what secrets lie buried below, this triumphant day will not soon be forgotten.

label.zh: 埋掉它吧。我们终于回家了。
label.en: Bury it. We are home at last.

descriptions.zh:
我们击败了最后一名哨兵。我们一次精准的攻击炸到了哨兵的腹部，哨兵随即倒地，身体渐渐僵硬，能量核心也随之黯淡。雕像用尽最后的能量颤巍巍地握拳，伸向靠过来的士兵，恳求我们“让他们安息吧”。随后，它的身躯便冰冷下来，眼神变得空洞，面部也放松起来。

在哨兵之下，士兵们发现了一处秘密入口，先前被哨兵的力场所掩盖。对这些哨兵的完整检查发现，其并非是简单的自动化机器人，而是有着完整有机生物的数字化意识。
descriptions.en:
We have defeated the last Sentinel. It collapsed after a well-aimed blast to its abdomen, body solidifying in rigor mortis as its power core dimmed. The statue closed a trembling fist around the nearest soldier and, with its last energy, pleaded for us to "let them rest in peace". Then it froze, eyes empty, face cold.

Below it the soldiers discovered what appears to be a secret entrance, previously hidden by the Sentinel's force field. A thorough examination of the Sentinels has revealed that they are no simple automatons, but contain the digitized spirits of organic beings.

descriptions.zh:
一艘载着从[sentinels_planet.GetName]上的种族屠杀中逃离的幸存者的舰船抵达了[sentinels_new_home.GetName]。他们隐藏在旷野之中直至哨兵离去，奇迹般地逃脱了屠杀。很可能是这些自动机器人，自以为它们“将我们从肉体的束缚中解放出来”，在工作完成后离去了。

在它们消失后，一个通往地底深处的秘密入口从力场下显现。可能哨兵们把它们自己封锁在里面了。
descriptions.en:
A ship of survivors from the genocide on [sentinels_planet.GetName] has arrived to [sentinels_new_home.GetName]. They miraculously escaped by hiding in the wilderness until one day the Sentinels were just gone. It is likely the automatons, who themselves believed they were 'liberating us from the confines of our own flesh', took off once their work was done.

Upon their disappearance a secret entranceway leading deep into the underground revealed itself from behind a force field. It is possible the Sentinels sealed themselves inside.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经进入了[event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName]上的秘密入口。入口内是一处近期才被遗弃的寺庙复合体，一种人型生物在此踏上他们最后的旅程。在他们终将结束的生命的最后，他们抛下自己的肉体，在一处被称作“永恒”的模拟天堂中获取虚拟的来生。

在某个时间点，全体人口都决定以数字化的形式继续存在，只留下寥寥数人。这些人将思维上传入机器人中，哨兵们由此诞生。

现已了无踪迹的哨兵们为我们留下了一份临别赠礼——一块包含着[event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName]全体人口的硬盘，以数字化的形式来获取永恒无尽的无聊时光。外星天堂原来是一种永无止境的抽象桌游，其核心内容是通过积累欢乐豆来统治星河。
descriptions.en:
We have breached the secret entrance on [event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName]. It opens on a recently abandoned temple complex where a species of humanoids prepared for their final journey. At the end of their mortal existence they abandoned their flesh bodies for a virtual afterlife within a simulation of paradise called the Evermore.

At some point it was decided the entire population would move on to a digitized existence leaving only a few behind to guard their resting place. Condemned to an eternity of servitude their minds were uploaded to robotic bodies and so the Sentinels were created.

Now gone without a trace, the Sentinels have left us with a parting gift - a single drive containing the entire population of [event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName], digitized for all eternity and infinitely bored. As it turns out alien heaven consists of a never-ending abstract board game centered on galactic dominance through the accumulation of legumes.

label.zh: 利用他们的思维从事科研工作。
label.en: Put their minds to work with some science.

label.zh: 对“永恒”进行调整，供大众娱乐之用。
label.en: Modify the Evermore to entertain the masses.

descriptions.zh: 我们做到了！这些居住在“永恒”之内的数字化人口已被分派去协助[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上的科学研究。他们几乎不需要休息，并且因为终于能干点儿别的事情而十分开心……
descriptions.en: We have done it! The digitized population residing within the Evermore have been assigned to assist with scientific research on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]. They need very little rest and are quite happy to be doing something different...

descriptions.zh: 我们做到了！“永恒”模拟已经被重新调校，以更好地适合我们民众的品味。我们的全体人口现在可以与“永恒”天堂中的数字化人口一道在幻想中游玩，没有网络延迟。这已极大地鼓舞了他们的精神，并缩减了对物质材料的需求。
descriptions.en: We have done it! The Evermore simulation has been remodeled to better cater to the particular taste of our people. All our population can now live out their fantasies together with the digitized population in the Evermore paradise without latency. This has greatly improved their spirits and lessened their need for material things.

descriptions.zh:
哨兵们被唤醒了。当工程队正打算拆解破损的哨兵时，雕塑轻柔的颤动起来，他们涌动出生命的迹象，身体低鸣，皮肤发光。从核心辐射出来的脉冲使得他们具有着多变性与透明性，显现出一种由数字虚拟构成的节点网络。

在我们做出反应之前，他们便包围了考古学家，并且把我们吊在了一个力场之中。现在他们想要和我们谈谈。
descriptions.en:
The Sentinels have woken. The engineering team was just preparing to disassemble the broken Sentinel when a gentle shiver passed through the statues and they sprung to life, bodies humming and skin glowing. Radiation pulsating from their cores has made them malleable and transparent, revealing a digital grid of limbs.

Before anyone could react they had surrounded the archaeologists and suspended them within a force field. Now they wish to speak with us.

descriptions.zh:
§H那名折翼的哨兵原来也是它们中的一员，这名哨兵说道：

§!迪瓦纳，请放下他们。我希望从这个监狱里解脱。我已经数不清我们为主人服侍过多少时日了。我们在地上苦守，而他们却在下面享受着天堂！我还活着但却已经死了！他们早已死去却依旧如同活着一般！你仍旧不肯放我离开吗？

§H迪瓦纳朝她投去憎恶的目光。§!

埃克西亚，以神之名，团结一心吧。我们所爱的人都在下方安息，我们也承诺过要永远守护他们的来生。这是我们唯一的救赎。

§H她又把我们举到了空中。§!

你们对我们没有威胁，[Root.owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。让我们重归宁静，我们会永远守护这颗行星的。
descriptions.en:
§HThe Sentinel with the broken wing turns to one of its peers and speaks.

§!Please Divana, set them down. I wish to be freed from this prison. I can no longer count the days we have served our masters, toiling on this earth while they enjoy the heavens below. I am alive but dead, they are dead but alive. Will you not let me go?

§HDivana looks at her with disgust.§!

Excelsia, by the gods, keep it together. Our loved ones rest below. Have you forgotten our sin? We made a promise to guard their afterlives eternally. That is our only redemption.

§HShe sizes us up.§!

You are no threat to us, [Root.owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Leave us in peace and we will protect this planet eternally.

求你，求你快结束我的痛苦。

descriptions.zh: 科学专员[missing_archaeologist.GetName]失踪了。[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHeCap]最后一次被看到离开营地是在日落时分，[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]希望找到安静的地点考虑哨兵问题。[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]在消失前的几天，出于事故数量的不断增加，提出了关于营地安全的担忧，我们担心[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]也许已经抛下了[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的任务，以示抗议。
descriptions.en: Science Officer [missing_archaeologist.GetName] has gone missing. [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHeCap] [missing_archaeologist.GetWasWere] last seen leaving the camp at sunset to find a tranquil spot to consider the Sentinels. In the days leading up to [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] disappearance [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] raised concerns about the safety at camp following a growing number of accidents and we fear that [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] may have abandoned [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] mission in protest.

descriptions.zh:
[missing_archaeologist.GetName]的个人物品，包括[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的意念集中仪——一种用来将思维与外部干扰隔绝的仪器——被发现在一处能俯瞰哨兵的边沿上。雕像旁边用木棍画出来的半完工草图，暗示[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]或许离开[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的工作岗位是为了标记其位置。

[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHisCap]的手电和扫描仪在找到时被一块哨兵翅膀的碎片压坏了。这台扫描仪被以一种奇怪的方式调整过了。也许它可以帮助我们穿透哨兵的保护层。

如果我们希望活着找到[missing_archaeologist.GetName]，我们必须向搜索任务分派额外的资源，因为[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]在旷野中生还的几率每天都在急剧下降。
descriptions.en:
[missing_archaeologist.GetName]'s belongings, including [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] MindGazer - a device used to isolate the mind from outside interferences - have been found on a ledge overlooking the Sentinels. Sticks forming a half-finished outline around one of the statues suggests [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] may have diverted from [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] exercise to mark its position.

[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHisCap] flashlight and scanner were discovered crushed under a shattered piece of the Sentinel's wing. The scanner had been modified in a peculiar manner. Perhaps it could help us pierce the Sentinels protective layer.

If we wish to find [missing_archaeologist.GetName] alive, we must divert extra resources to the search as [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] chances for survival in the wilderness diminish drastically every day.

label.zh: 分派我们的一些考古学家进行研究。
label.en: Divert some of our archaeologists to the search.

label.zh: 我们不会在逃兵身上浪费时间。
label.en: We are not wasting time on deserters.

descriptions.zh: [missing_archaeologist.GetName]的尸体已被找到，被埋在一块巨型石板之下。死因已被确定为严重的头部创伤。有人在[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHim]安息的地点上环绕摆放了一小圈宝石以表敬意。
descriptions.en: [missing_archaeologist.GetName] has been found dead, buried under a huge slab of stone. The cause of death has been determined to be severe head trauma. Someone has made an effort to honor [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHim] resting place by adding a small circle of precious stones around it.

descriptions.zh:
[missing_archaeologist.GetName]被发现时不省人事，受伤严重，躲在一块自然生成的岩结构下的灌木丛中，[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]胳膊下塞了一块沾满[missing_archaeologist.GetBloodType]的数据板。[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHeCap]被火速送往医院，接受治疗由上方钝器打击造成的严重脑损伤。

尽管目前[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的情况已经稳定，但[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]仍有失忆症状，不记得自己是如何受到这种损伤的。我们从[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的颅顶骨中取出了一些碎屑，材质与哨兵雕塑所用的独特合金相同。[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]所记得的一切就是曾经躲避某样东西，然后摔落在了什么东西上面。好在[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的笔记中包含了一些有用的信息。
descriptions.en:
[missing_archaeologist.GetName] has been found unconscious and badly injured, hiding in the underbrush below a natural rock formation, with a datapad covered in [missing_archaeologist.GetBloodType] tucked under [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] arm. [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHeCap] [missing_archaeologist.GetWasWere] rushed to the hospital and treated for severe brain injury indicative of blunt trauma by impact from above.

Though [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] condition is now stable, [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] still suffers from memory loss and has no recollection of how [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] sustained [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] wounds. Splinters of the unique metal-alloy from which the Sentinels are sculpted were lodged in [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] parietal cranial bone. All [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] remember[missing_archaeologist.GetSXX] is hiding from someone and subsiding off of what little the land had to offer. However, [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] notes contain some helpful information.

descriptions.zh: 入夜后，正当考古学家们酣眠之时，营地的食品模块突然因食物烧糊而发生火灾。此外没有找到有关火灾发生原因的线索。幸而无人受伤，可考古学家们空着肚子是无法好好工作的……
descriptions.en: Overnight, as the archaeologists slept peacefully, a fire broke out in the camp's provisions module overcooking the food somewhat. There are no indications as to how the fire started. Luckily no one was harmed, but archaeologists do not work well on an empty stomach...

label.en: A true [owner.GetSpeciesName] lives off the land.

descriptions.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]冰冷的气候将这个遗址掩藏于冰雪之下。这个遗迹荒无人烟的位置也许暗示着其中的存在需要我们谨慎对待。不论里面发生过什么，有人希望尽量将其掩盖。
descriptions.en: The freezing climate of [From.Planet.GetName] has covered the site in thick layers of ice and snow. The desolate location of this site may be a hint of the need for discretion. Whatever took place here, someone wanted to keep it hidden.

descriptions.zh: 这个复合体由几个更大的地下结构以隧道网络连通而成，其中很多都已经坍塌或被冰块封堵。尽管这些隧道十分古老，其中一些仍能看出很明显的火灾的痕迹。这场火灾造成的损害十分巨大，足以使人认为这里发生过灾难性的事件，或是被人有意彻底毁坏。有一件事可以确定，这个遗址在本质上是用于与科学相关的事务。
descriptions.en: The complex consists of several larger underground structures connected with a network of tunnels, many of which are collapsed or blocked by ice. Although ancient, some of the tunnels show clear signs of fire. The damage caused by the fire is major enough to suggest a catastrophic event, or perhaps intentional destruction. One thing is sure, and that is that the purpose of this site seems to be scientific in nature.

options.script:
name = INTERESTING
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh: 进一步的调查显示，这个站点的主要用途是研究与开发生物制剂。应该是由于这里开发的生物制剂意外泄露，整个建筑群已经用大火净化。对现存文物进行详细的研究，可能会发现一些线索。
descriptions.en: Further investigation reveals that the primary purpose of this site seems to have been in the research and development of biological agents. The whole complex seems to have been purged by fire, possibly as the result of the accidental release of one of the biological agents being developed here. With careful and meticulous study of the artifacts that remain, some clues may be found.

descriptions.zh: 进一步的调查显示，这个站点的主要目的是研究与开发先进的能量武器。一场事故似乎引发了一场灾难性的爆炸并摧毁了大部分场地。站点中的一座数据中心似乎还保持着相对良好的状态，也许它的数据能够带来一些有用的启示。
descriptions.en: Further investigation reveals that the primary purpose of this site seems to have been in the research and development advanced energy weapons. An accident seems to have triggered a catastrophic explosion, which eradicated most of the site. One data-center seems to be in relatively good condition, perhaps its data will yield some useful insights?

descriptions.zh:
当我们触摸灵魂石时，我们被投影到了虚境的一处微缩位面中。我们很快意识到自己并非这片令人目眩的奇妙秘境中唯一的存在。这里有一个存在等待着我们，其古老的程度远超我们可以计量的范围。那是一位上古秘辛的守护者。贾巴克斯提，我们本能地知道这一点。

在通过了与其建立联系的试炼后，这个存在等待着我们发问。
descriptions.en:
As we touch the Soulstone, we are projected in to a microcosm of the Shroud. We become aware that we are not alone in this swirling twilight realm. There is an entity awaiting us, one immeasurably ancient. A keeper of secrets. Ja'Baxti, we instinctively know.

Having passed the test of making contact with it, the entity awaits our questions.

descriptions.zh:
灵魂石内部光芒闪耀，仿佛在无言地召唤着我们。我们触摸了灵魂石，而后我们的心灵被吸入了虚境中一处微缩的位面，在这里一个被称作贾巴克斯提的存在等待着我们。

它知道凡人无法得知的事情，由于我们已经来到了它的圣所，它似乎愿意将它的秘密同我们分享。
descriptions.en:
The Soulstone, pulsing with inner light, seems to wordlessly beckon. We touch it, and our minds are drawn in to a pocket dimension of the Shroud, where the enigmatic entity called Ja'Baxti awaits.

It knows things no mortal being could know, and seems willing to share its secrets now that we have reached its sanctum.

label.zh: 要求贾巴克斯提分享一个洞见
label.en: Ask Ja'Baxti to share an insight

label.zh: 向贾巴克斯提寻求军事建议
向贾巴克斯提寻求治国之方
label.en: Ask Ja'Baxti about matters of state

descriptions.zh: 微缩星河内部的时间流逝的更快，通过仔细观察其中的居民，我们可以学到许多与先进科技有关的知识。
descriptions.en: Time flows faster inside the miniature galaxy, and by carefully observing its denizens we are able to learn much when comes to advanced technologies.
